title: Ranges and NOT in sale_items · part 3

steps.title: Keep id from 41 to 42
steps.prompt:
BETWEEN lo AND hi keeps a range (both ends included).
It is a tidy way to write two comparisons at once.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE id BETWEEN 41 AND 42;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sale_items.
Add WHERE id BETWEEN …
Write the two ends with AND between them.
Write: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE id BETWEEN 41 AND 42;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE id BETWEEN 41 AND 42;
steps.memory_trick: BETWEEN a AND b = a <= x <= b.

steps.title: Keep id outside 41..42
steps.prompt: NOT flips a test: NOT (something) means 'the opposite'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE NOT (id BETWEEN 41 AND 42);
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sale_items.
Wrap the range in brackets after NOT.
NOT ( id BETWEEN 41 AND 42 ).
Write: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE NOT (id BETWEEN 41 AND 42);
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE NOT (id BETWEEN 41 AND 42);
steps.memory_trick: NOT reverses whatever is inside the brackets.
